main_text.l: In quarta, Generaliora sphalmata Domi-
ni Cl. in relatione sua de Oeconomia
mea Divina.
In quinta, Specialiora sphalmata ejusdem
in eadem de Oeconomia Divina rela-
tione.
In sexta, de articulo quodam Præfationis
Tomi V. Bibliothecæ Universalis, &
de convicio quodam in Tomo sequenti.
In septima, quantum fidei Domini Cl. re-
lationibus de aliorum libris sit haben-
dum, aliquot exemplis ostenditur.
In octava, de ejus in sanctiores Ecclesiæ Pa-
tres, præsertim in S. Augustinum invec-
tivarum perpetuarum causis, fide & æ-
quitate, nec non de ejusdem irrisorio
genio agitur.
In nona denique, plura esse in ejus scriptis
& propositis irridenda & carpenda,
quam quæ in aliis ipse irrisit & carpsit;
sed optandum alia & Christianis magis
digna methodo dedoceri errores.

page.notes: Printed in a mix of roman and italic type; the word "AUCTORI" at the lower right is a signature-like catchword, placed here as a bottom element. Scan shows show-through and speckle, which were omitted.
